about:
I am an Electronics and Communication Engineering student at PES University with hands-on experience in robotics, CAD modelling, robot kinematics, embedded systems, and physics-based simulation.

I am currently developing a quadruped robotic platform at MARS C-IoT Lab using Fusion 360, URDF, and PyBullet.

My interests include ROS 2, sensor fusion, computer vision, and simulation-driven development for autonomous robotics research.
